passages.quote:
This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Seamen’s Wages and Accounts) (Fishing Vessels) Regulations 1972 as amended and the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018 and replaces MGN 585 (F).

Amendment 1 updates reference information only.

Annex A - suggested format for an allotment note, is also available in a printable version attached separately to this notice.

Notice to

fishing vessel owners

managers

employers of fishermen

fishermen
